acceptance_criterion: Provide an xHCI driver so USB devices plugged into USB3 ports can be used.

evidence.contrast: boot/bootdata/txtsetup.sif lines 113/118/119 already list usbhub3.sys, usbxhci.sys, ucx01000.sys in [SourceDisksFiles]; boot/bootdata/hivesys.inf lines 52-54 and 95-96 already map PCI#CC_0C0330 to usbxhci and USB#ROOT_HUB30 to usbhub3.
evidence.pinned_lines: [HardwareIdsDatabase] 175-181 has USB\ROOT_HUB, USB\ROOT_HUB20, PCI\CC_0C0300/0310/0320 but no USB\ROOT_HUB30 or PCI\CC_0C0330; [InputDevicesSupport.Load] 197-204 has usbehci/usbohci/usbuhci/usbhub/usbccgp/hidusb/usbstor but no usbxhci/ucx01000/usbhub3.

gap: Install-time (usetup) binding is absent at the pinned tree: USB3 controller and root hub are not in [HardwareIdsDatabase] or [InputDevicesSupport.Load] of boot/bootdata/txtsetup.sif, so an xHCI-only machine has no USB during text setup (no install media, no keyboard).
